data.body: **[P2] Clean up completed start hooks before propagating a later fatal.** `runUserFunction` invokes this outside the `try` that emits `onUserFunctionEnd`. If OTel opens an attempt scope and a later plugin fails, OTel receives no attempt-end callback; under a direct executor, scopes then close out of order and can restore stale context on the reusable thread. Track successfully started plugins and run their failure cleanup before rethrowing the fatal; add OTel-first/fatal-second coverage.
